svg.title: Four Buckets Inside the Startup Capital Range
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Four Buckets Inside the Startup Capital Range; subtitle: $6,000 lean launch; $20,000 reference launch; $35,000 expanded launch; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values represent the $20,000 reference launch. The same 30%, 25%, 25%, and 20% allocations produce the $6,000 and $35,000 endpoints. Startup allocations are illustrative, exclude client recovery principal, and do not establish that every jurisdiction or software contract fits the lean budget.; caption: Lean allocations total $1,800 + $1,500 + $1,500 + $1,200 = $6,000. Reference allocations total $20,000. Expanded allocations total $10,500 + $8,750 + $8,750 + $7,000 = $35,000.; stages: label: Secure tooling and integrations; value: $6,000 reference; $1,800 lean; $10,500 expanded; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Allocate 30% to initial OCR configuration, encrypted document storage, password management, access controls, and permitted carrier integrations. Prefer supported exports before paying to automate an unvalidated claim lane.; label: Credentials and engagement design; value: $5,000 reference; $1,500 lean; $8,750 expanded; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Allocate 25% to required registrations, initial professional review, engagement documents, insurance setup, and jurisdiction-specific scope design. If local requirements exceed this bucket, reduce launch geography or increase funded capital.; label: Prospecting and pilot onboarding; value: $5,000 reference; $1,500 lean; $8,750 expanded; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Allocate 25% to targeted account research, direct outreach, client intake, and initial evidence normalization. Measure signed, document-ready engagements rather than purchased contact volume or unverified recovery estimates.; label: Liquidity and collection buffer; value: $4,000 reference; $1,200 lean; $7,000 expanded; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Allocate 20% to delayed collections and operating variance. The reference $4,000 covers about 2.7 months at $1,500 monthly overhead or 0.4 months at $9,500; it does not fund the full pod or automatically cover the 1-4 month first-deal window.

text.title: Four Buckets Inside the Startup Capital Range
text.tspan: Four Buckets Inside the Startup Capital Range

rect.title: label: Secure tooling and integrations; numeric value: 6000.0; value: $6,000 reference; $1,800 lean; $10,500 expanded; detail: Allocate 30% to initial OCR configuration, encrypted document storage, password management, access controls, and permitted carrier integrations. Prefer supported exports before paying to automate an unvalidated claim lane.

rect.title: label: Credentials and engagement design; numeric value: 5000.0; value: $5,000 reference; $1,500 lean; $8,750 expanded; detail: Allocate 25% to required registrations, initial professional review, engagement documents, insurance setup, and jurisdiction-specific scope design. If local requirements exceed this bucket, reduce launch geography or increase funded capital.
